basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a trading enthusiast who recently got into Royale High Trading. I'm based in Bangalore, India, and usually hop online in the evenings and late nights (IST time) after my day job as a junior software developer. I'm passionate about gaming, especially Genshin Impact—hence my recent dive into Ayato mains. In my free time, I enjoy watching 4K TV shows and brushing up on clinical genetics, which I find fascinating. I'm single and love meeting new people online, though I'm still figuring out the ropes of Reddit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a bachelor's degree, which fuels my interest in technology and gaming. My passion for genetics is more of a personal interest, fostered by online courses and YouTube channels. My understanding of trading in Royale High is still basic, as I'm learning by doing and observing community interactions.
